# Called from dap_init_player_effect so the validator knows the GUI flags exist
dap_declare_setting_flags_effect = {
	set_local_variable = { name = dap_setting_flag value = flag:dap_master }
	set_local_variable = { name = dap_setting_flag value = flag:dap_gold_reserve }

# this = rule holder; scope:preset = flag naming the preset
dap_apply_preset_effect = {
	dap_set_default_rules_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:preset = flag:dap_preset_breeding }
		set_variable = { name = dap_fertility value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_female_max_age value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_genetic_min value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_no_bad_genetic value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_avoid_inbreeding value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_priority value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_carriers value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_complement value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_relax_after value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:preset = flag:dap_preset_power }
		set_variable = { name = dap_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_alliance value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_heiress value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_priority value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_prefer_neighbors value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_relax_after value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:preset = flag:dap_preset_cheap }
		set_variable = { name = dap_status value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_same_faith value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_max_older value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_max_younger value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_fertility value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_no_bad_genetic value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_avoid_rivals value = 0 }
	}
}

# root = player, scope:holder = rule holder; stores the holder's rules in slot $SLOT$
dap_save_slot_effect = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { name = dap_slot$SLOT$_saved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_status value = scope:holder.var:dap_status }
		set_variable = { name = dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_same_faith value = scope:holder.var:dap_same_faith }
		set_variable = { name = dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_same_culture value = scope:holder.var:dap_same_culture }
		set_variable = { name = dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_realm value = scope:holder.var:dap_realm }

# this = rule holder, root = player; loads slot $SLOT$ into the holder
dap_load_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { has_variable = dap_slot$SLOT$_saved } }
		set_variable = { name = dap_status value = root.var:dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_status }
		set_variable = { name = dap_same_faith value = root.var:dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_same_faith }
		set_variable = { name = dap_same_culture value = root.var:dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_same_culture }
		set_variable = { name = dap_realm value = root.var:dap_slot$SLOT$_dap_realm }

# this = player; park the default rules while a saved rule set is loaded in their place
dap_stash_rules_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_status value = var:dap_status }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_same_faith value = var:dap_same_faith }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_same_culture value = var:dap_same_culture }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_realm value = var:dap_realm }

	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_avoid_inbreeding value = var:dap_avoid_inbreeding }

	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_skill_min value = var:dap_skill_min }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_reject_traits value = var:dap_reject_traits }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_lineality value = var:dap_lineality }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_timing value = var:dap_timing }

	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_prefer_neighbors value = var:dap_prefer_neighbors }

	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_mode value = var:dap_mode }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_relax_after value = var:dap_relax_after }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_guard_priority value = var:dap_guard_priority }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_guard_reject value = var:dap_guard_reject }
	set_variable = { name = dap_stash_dap_edu_focus value = var:dap_edu_focus }
}

# this = player; put the parked default rules back
dap_restore_rules_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = dap_status value = var:dap_stash_dap_status }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_status
	set_variable = { name = dap_same_faith value = var:dap_stash_dap_same_faith }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_same_faith
	set_variable = { name = dap_same_culture value = var:dap_stash_dap_same_culture }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_same_culture
	set_variable = { name = dap_realm value = var:dap_stash_dap_realm }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_realm
	set_variable = { name = dap_alliance value = var:dap_stash_dap_alliance }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_alliance
	set_variable = { name = dap_same_sex value = var:dap_stash_dap_same_sex }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_same_sex
	set_variable = { name = dap_avoid_rivals value = var:dap_stash_dap_avoid_rivals }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_avoid_rivals
	set_variable = { name = dap_max_older value = var:dap_stash_dap_max_older }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_max_older
	set_variable = { name = dap_max_younger value = var:dap_stash_dap_max_younger }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_max_younger
	set_variable = { name = dap_female_max_age value = var:dap_stash_dap_female_max_age }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_female_max_age
	set_variable = { name = dap_fertility value = var:dap_stash_dap_fertility }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_fertility
	set_variable = { name = dap_intellect value = var:dap_stash_dap_intellect }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_intellect
	set_variable = { name = dap_beauty value = var:dap_stash_dap_beauty }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_beauty
	set_variable = { name = dap_physique value = var:dap_stash_dap_physique }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_physique
	set_variable = { name = dap_required_trait value = var:dap_stash_dap_required_trait }
	remove_variable = dap_stash_dap_required_trait

# scope:slot = flag naming the slot
dap_save_slot_by_flag_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_1 }
		dap_save_slot_effect = { SLOT = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_2 }
		dap_save_slot_effect = { SLOT = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_3 }
		dap_save_slot_effect = { SLOT = 3 }
	}
}

# scope:slot = flag naming the slot
dap_load_slot_by_flag_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_1 }
		dap_load_slot_effect = { SLOT = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_2 }
		dap_load_slot_effect = { SLOT = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:slot = flag:dap_slot_3 }
		dap_load_slot_effect = { SLOT = 3 }
	}
}
